sentences.text:
Heard Sri Subodh Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Devesh Vikram, learned
Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

2.  The petitioners have preferred this writ petition for the following relief- "i) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents No.2 & 3 to pay compensation to the petitioners in respect of their Araji bearing No.381 area 600 Sq Gaj =501.92 Sq. Mt. situated at Mauja Dev Ghat,
Pargana, Tahsil and District-Prayagraj which they have acquired vide Notification No. 1317/VI- Nayay-1-13-122-2011 dated 22.3.2013 followed by the award dated 16.3.2015 along with interest as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
ii) to issue any other writ, order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper to which the petitioners are entitled under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013;
iii) to award heavy costs of this petition to the petitioners."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in spite of the fact that land of the petitioner had been acquired; till date the respondents had not accorded any compensation to them.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In such situation, petitioners have invoked the instant writ petition.

4. Sri Devesh Vikram, learned ACSC has placed a detailed instruction and submits that the acquisition proceedings had commenced by invocation of Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (in short 'Act 1894') on 31.12.2011, which was published in Gazette on 07.01.2012 and also published in two newspapers namely, Amar Ujala and Amrit Prabhat or Safire Nav on 24.03.2012 and 23.03.2012 respectively.
Local publication was also made on 24.03.2012.

Later on, the final declaration under Section 6(1) of the Act, 1894 were also issued on 22.03.2013, which got published Parwez Ahmad Siddiqui And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172811037/
2 in Gazette on 30.03.2013 and two daily newspapers on 23.03.2013 and 23.03.2013.

entities.text: Parwez Ahmad Siddiqui And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Local publication was also made on 23.03.2013.
The possession was also taken over on 17.04.2017.

He submits that the land has already been vested in the state, free from all incumbrances, and there was a dispute of aportionment at the time of acquisition, as name of the petitioner were not recorded in the revenue record.

In view of the provisions under Sections 76/77 of the Land Acquisition Act,
2013, the matter was referred to the LARRA (Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority) Court.

entities.text: LARRA (Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority) Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The amount has already been deposited to the LARRA Court, in view of the award dated 16.03.2015.
5. Considering the factual situation and the relief as prayed for it is not in dispute that the land has been acquired.

The only dispute is that the rightful claim had been denied to the petitioner on account of two objections; firstly that they were not recorded in the revenue record and secondly,
there was dispute of apportionment and accordingly, the matter has been referred to the LARRA Court in view of the provisions under Section 76 read with Section 77 of the Act, 2013 where the proceeding are pending consideration.

6. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and in the interest of justice to protect the constitutional right of the petitioners, in case, the petitioners approach to the LARRA Court within three weeks from today, we expect the grievance of the petitioners shall be redressed in accordance with law.
7. With the aforesaid observation, writ petition stands disposed of.

(Kunal Ravi Singh,J.) (Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.) November 7, 2025 Priya  Parwez Ahmad Siddiqui And Another vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172811037/
